name: 28/28 Agent Service Desk: Fix & Verify
summary: 据注册表条目介绍，28/28 Agent Service Desk MCP 服务器可检查域名的 SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC 配置，提供无约束力的修复报价，并在 DNS 修改后复查。

According to its registry listing, the 28/28 Agent Service Desk MCP server checks a domain’s SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings, provides a non-binding quote for remediation, and rechecks the settings after DNS changes.
